description: Make the purchase order an approved request for proposal (RFP) decides, as the RFP screen's Generate Purchase Order does: a new purchase order in Created status with the RFP's supplier, warehouse, lines and due date, and the RFP marked fulfilled. Nothing is sent to the supplier; issue the order with issue_purchase_order. A person approves the RFP first, in the app; an unapproved RFP is refused. Find RFPs with get_purchase_orders type=rfp. Two-step: preview=true, then commit with the previewReceipt. Requires Write + purchasing.execute.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is written until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

requestForProposal.description: Request for proposal id (GUID), document number, or the short form people use for an open one: its last digits ("42", "RFP 42").

name: convert_rfp_to_purchase_order
title: Convert RFP to Purchase Order
